modelDescription:
Precision Matched Receiver Set • Machined from US‑produced 7075 T651 aluminum
• Mil‑Spec Type III Class 2 hardcoat anodized finish
Billet Fixed Magazine Lower Receiver • Threaded bolt catch screw
• M4 cut low‑rear‑shelf trigger pocket
• Extended takedown & pivot pins
Billet Upper Receiver • Mil‑Spec pinned forward assist
• Threaded forward assist screw
• Mil‑Spec dry film lubricated bore
Partial Ambidextrous Controls • DSI Atach ambi charging handle
• DSI billet ambi 90° safety selector
• Mil‑Spec investment‑cast bolt catch
• Premium investment‑cast single‑stage trigger (6–7 lb pull)
DSI Mil+ Bolt Carrier Group • 8620 bolt carrier (diamond‑honed bore)
• 9310 bolt (enhanced profile)
• 4130 gas key (Grade 8+ Torx‑staked)
• 8740 steel ground chrome firing pin
• Springco XP 5‑coil extractor spring
DSI 10.5" SOCOM Profile Barrel • 4150 CMV steel (MIL‑B‑11595E)
• Button‑rifled; twist options: 1:7 or 1:9 (1:8 .300 Blk)
• Carbine or mid‑length gas system
• Black nitride heat‑treat finish
DSI Mil+ Carbine Buffer System • Neoprene‑dampened buffer with bump‑stop
• Electropolished 17‑7 stainless spring
• 7075 buffer tube (6‑position, drain/vent holes)
• Dry film lubricant in tube bore
• Dual‑staked QD end plate & castle nut
Included Accessories • 10‑round polymer magazine
• Keyed cable lock
